name: apple-photos
description: Search, inspect, export, and safely organize an Apple Photos library on macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Search, export, and safely organize Apple Photos on macOS.
interface.longDescription: Search an Apple Photos library by date, album, person, place, keyword, or metadata; inspect albums and assets; export originals, edits, and sidecars; and preview tightly scoped album or metadata changes before applying them.
defaultPrompt: Use $apple-photos to inspect my Photos library safely and carry out the requested workflow.
